title: Swap 100 USDC into WETH for Bob

steps.title: Alice asks the router to swap
steps.body: Alice asks the router to turn 100 USDC into WETH and send it to Bob. She wants at least 0.04 WETH.

steps.title: The router checks the path
steps.body: The router checks how many tokens are on the swap path.

steps.title: The router has USDC move the funds
steps.body: The router asks USDC to move Alice's 100 USDC to the pool.

steps.title: USDC checks the allowance
steps.body: USDC checks that what Alice allowed the router covers the amount.

steps.title: 100 USDC moves from Alice to the pool
steps.body: USDC takes 100 from Alice, adds it to the pool, and lowers the allowance by what was used.

steps.title: USDC reports that it is done
steps.body: USDC tells the router it has moved the funds. The changes are still provisional.
steps.gist: The moved funds stay provisional until the swap ends

steps.title: The router asks the pool to swap
steps.body: The router asks the pool to turn the USDC into WETH and send it to Bob.

steps.title: The pool prices the swap
steps.body: At its current rate, the pool works out how much WETH 100 USDC is worth.

steps.title: 0.05 WETH meets the minimum
steps.body: The pool checks that the 0.05 WETH it pays is at least the 0.04 WETH Alice asked for.

steps.title: The pool has WETH pay Bob
steps.body: The pool asks WETH to send 0.05 WETH to Bob.

steps.title: 0.05 WETH moves from the pool to Bob
steps.body: WETH takes 0.05 from the pool and adds it to Bob.

steps.title: WETH reports that it is done
steps.body: WETH tells the pool it has sent the funds.

steps.title: The pool reports what it paid
steps.body: The pool tells the router it paid 0.05 WETH. An inner call returning leaves the changes provisional.
steps.gist: An inner call returning leaves the changes provisional

steps.title: The swap ends
steps.body: The outermost call returns, and every change becomes final here.
steps.gist: Every change becomes final when the outermost call returns
